# MACZONE 0.1.0 preview

Native, open-source window layouts for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.

## Downloads

- **MACZONE-0.1.0-arm64-preview.dmg** — drag MACZONE.app into Applications.
- **MACZONE Layouts.alfredworkflow** — optional Alfred Powerpack workflow for cycling and selecting six layout slots. Install MACZONE in Applications first.

## Highlights

- Visual zone editor and menu-bar snap grid
- Keyboard shortcuts, per-display and per-Space layouts, saved sessions, and app rules
- Shared-edge window resizing and swapping
- Local `maczone://` automation used by the Alfred workflow

## Before installing

This preview is ad-hoc signed and **not notarized by Apple**. macOS Gatekeeper may block its first launch. After trying to open MACZONE, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** for this app, then confirm. Do not turn Gatekeeper off globally. MACZONE requires macOS window-control permission to move other apps' windows. This build supports Apple Silicon only.

The app and workflow source are available in this repository under GPL-3.0. A Developer ID signed and notarized download is planned.
